description: M13 set B: questions about things that are not in the pinned Flask checkout. Written before any M13 code or run. Each topic was checked by a case-insensitive search of the Python files of the pinned checkout (zero matches for graphql, websocket, postgres, oauth, smtp, jwt, kafka, grpc, django, docker, migrat, rate limit, machine learning; SQLAlchemy occurs only as a docs link in docs/conf.py).
